messages:
Maya Chen (AE): Quick ask — Whispered Harbor (startup) wants a custom 6-month commit with 45% off list for inference. They expect 1.2M tokens/mo. Can we do this as a small strategic pilot? Link to convo: https://gd.doc/whispered-harbor
Liam O'Neill (Finance): 45% is above standard SDR limits. We need revenue expectations and whether they prepay. Any churn risk after 6mo?
Maya Chen (AE): They'll prepay 3 months now, then monthly. They asked that discount be applied across the commit. They're growth-stage, potential reference customer.
Rosa Kim (RevOps): Suggest guardrails: 1) cap discount to $40k total credit, 2) require PO + signed addendum, 3) tag billing as "Commit - Whispered Harbor (Q2 pilot)", 4) overage charged at list.
Jonas Meyer (Legal): Can approve addendum with audit clause and expiry. Recommend phrase: "Discount is conditional on Customer meeting minimum usage thresholds each billing period; failure voids remaining credits."
deal-bot: Automated check — requested discount override (45%) requires Finance + Legal approval. Case logged: deal-2945671230.
Liam O'Neill (Finance): Approved conditionally: up to 45% but capped to $40k credit, prepaid 3mo or PO, signed addendum, and weekly usage reports. Finance sign-off: Liam O'Neill 2945671270
Maya Chen (AE): Awesome — I'll get the PO and signed addendum today. Will post signed doc here when complete :party_parrot:
